headline.en: Keep the proof attempts beside the generated code.
headline.zh: 把证明尝试与生成代码一起保留。

sub.en: ProofLoop asks a configured model for Python and Lean drafts, feeds checker errors back for repair, and saves the final sources with a record of each attempt.
sub.zh: ProofLoop 向配置的模型请求 Python 与 Lean 草稿，将检查器错误反馈用于修订，最后保存源文件及每次尝试记录。

body.en: Each attempt keeps its draft and checker error.
body.zh: 每次尝试保留草稿与检查器错误。

body.en: out.lean is available for independent checking.
body.zh: 可对 out.lean 独立检查。

body.en: Model and checker labels remain in the certificate.
body.zh: 证书保留模型与检查器标签。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Python 3.12+; the included driver reads the three artifacts from a complete stub run in a temporary directory.
note.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+；随仓驱动在临时目录完成一次 stub 运行，并回读三个产物。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Canned draft/repair loop with DemoBackend and DemoLeanChecker, followed by artifact readback. It is not a real Lean check or model-generated proof.

body.en: Python 3.12+; the included driver reads the three artifacts from a complete stub run in a temporary directory.
body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+；随仓驱动在临时目录完成一次 stub 运行，并回读三个产物。

title.zh: 零配置试用（无需 key、无需 Lean）

steps.code: uvx --from git+https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/proofloop proofloop prove "sum of the first n naturals = n(n+1)/2" --trace --stub

git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/proofloop.git
cd proofloop
python3.12 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: The demo checker passes any draft without sorry/admit. Its proof_passed flag is simulated and is not formal verification.
limitations.zh: 示例检查器会放行不含 sorry/admit 的草稿，其 proof_passed 是模拟结果，不代表形式化验证。

limitations.en: Even a real Lean acceptance checks the Lean statement, not equivalence of the Python program or fidelity to the natural-language claim. Review theorem assumptions and generated code.
limitations.zh: 即使真实 Lean 接受，也只检查 Lean 命题，不证明 Python 程序等价或自然语言需求被忠实表达；须检查定理假设与生成代码。

limitations.en: The CLI writes a certificate on exhaustion and does not necessarily return a nonzero status for an unproved claim. Inspect proof_passed, model and lean_version.
limitations.zh: 迭代耗尽后 CLI 仍写证书，未证明的命题不一定导致非零退出；应检查 proof_passed、model 与 lean_version。

body.en: A final answer hides how a proof was obtained and which check accepted it. Keeping draft, error and repair together makes the run inspectable and gives you the Lean source for independent checking.
body.zh: 最终回答容易隐藏证明如何得到、被哪个检查器接受。把草稿、错误与修订保存在一起，便于检查过程，也能拿 Lean 源文件独立验证。

body.en: The CLI resolves the model and checker. co_iterate parses fenced Python/Lean drafts, invokes the checker and asks for repair until success or the iteration cap. emit writes out.py, out.lean and certificate.json. --stub replaces both model and checker with bundled stand-ins.
body.zh: CLI 解析模型与检查器配置；co_iterate 从代码块读取 Python/Lean 草稿，调用检查器并请求修订，直至通过或达到次数上限。emit 写入 out.py、out.lean 与 certificate.json；--stub 将模型和检查器均替换为随仓模拟实现。

body.en: The CLI resolves the model and checker. co_iterate parses fenced Python/Lean drafts, invokes the checker and asks for repair until success or the iteration cap. emit writes out.py, out.lean and certificate.json. --stub replaces both model and checker with bundled stand-ins.
body.zh: CLI 解析模型与检查器配置；co_iterate 从代码块读取 Python/Lean 草稿，调用检查器并请求修订，直至通过或达到次数上限。emit 写入 out.py、out.lean 与 certificate.json；--stub 将模型和检查器均替换为随仓模拟实现。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: Set PROOFLOOP_API_KEY (or OPENAI_API_KEY), PROOFLOOP_BASE_URL, PROOFLOOP_MODEL, PROOFLOOP_MAX_ITER and PROOFLOOP_OUT_DIR for the real path; --base-url, --model, --lean, --max-iter and --out-dir override them. The real checker rejects sorry/admit text before invoking Lean and has a subprocess timeout. --stub needs neither key nor Lean.
body.zh: 真实路径设置 PROOFLOOP_API_KEY（或 OPENAI_API_KEY）、PROOFLOOP_BASE_URL、PROOFLOOP_MODEL、PROOFLOOP_MAX_ITER 与 PROOFLOOP_OUT_DIR；--base-url、--model、--lean、--max-iter、--out-dir 可覆盖环境配置。真实检查器先拒绝 sorry/admit 文本，再调用带超时的 Lean 子进程；--stub 无需密钥或 Lean。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
proofloop prove "sum of the first n natural numbers" --stub --trace --out-dir demo-output
# Convergence benchmark over the bundled claims library (offline demo):
proofloop bench --stub --out-dir bench-output
# With a configured API key and Lean executable:
proofloop prove "sum of the first n natural numbers" --trace --max-iter 8 --out-dir proof-output
